rows.name: RiskMandate
rows.what: Sells a behaviour policy per AI agent that shows what the agent can reach, what it was authorised to do, the gap between the two, and the barriers in between; the about page says it is never a score.
rows.price_line: Four levels stated in GBP: 500 (one agent), 1,500 (worked through with you), 5,000 (about two days, several agents), 20,000 (whole-estate engagement); each currently starts with a conversation as payment links are not yet issued.
rows.note: no user-need column: RiskMandate's users are not in sherpa.d's needs yet

rows.name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
rows.what: Gives each AI agent its own identity account in Entra ID so its actions can be told apart from human and workload identities, with autonomous or delegated access via tokens.
rows.price_line: Agent ID is stated as available to all Entra customers, but extending Entra security features to agents needs a Microsoft Agent 365 licence (in M365 E7 or an add-on to E5/A5/Business Premium).
rows.note: no user-need column: RiskMandate's users are not in sherpa.d's needs yet

rows.name: Okta (secure AI agents)
